_comment: One worked example per op. Each is a valid input file for the script named in its _use_with (keys starting with _ are annotations the scripts ignore). Copy one, edit the values, save, then: bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/executing-plans/scripts/<op>.sh path/to/input.json

run_step__shell_command._why: PREFERRED PATH for shell-based steps. Bundles start+exec+complete with auto-captured log_context. Eliminates the 'forgot to pass log_context' footgun the same way migration 006 eliminated 'forgot to call finish-plan'.

run_step__with_summary._why: Override the auto-generated summary with a curated one-liner.
run_step__with_summary.summary: Migrated DB to head: adds Steps.is_review + idx_steps_plan_review.

start_step__sub_agent.agent_input: Refactor app/auth/oauth.py: extract OAuthClient.fetch_token into a separate token_service module. Preserve public API. Run pytest after.

complete_step__with_summary.summary: Read app/health.py + identified 3 singletons: db_session, worker_registry, disk_monitor. Mapped to 4 probe functions for deep_health().

complete_step__sub_agent_with_output.summary: Sub-agent extracted token_service module + 6 tests pass + zero public-API regression
complete_step__sub_agent_with_output.agent_output: Created app/auth/token_service.py with TokenService class. OAuthClient now delegates fetch_token() to it. tests/test_oauth.py and tests/test_token_service.py both green. No callers broken.

complete_step__with_inline_log._why: Use inline log_context (Bug 2 fix) when you have raw output ready at completion time — saves a separate append-log call and ensures the log isn't forgotten. Same `--- ts ---` delimiter as append-log so dashboard counters keep working.

raise_budget__after_the_loop_breaker._why: The loop breaker refused a deviate at 5/5 and the extra revisions are warranted. This is the ONLY way to lift the ceiling; the reason is required and the raise is recorded as a deviation on the plan, so the new budget is itself auditable.
raise_budget__after_the_loop_breaker.reason: two of the five revisions were mid-flight corrections from the coordinator, not plan defects; one recovery sub-step is still to open

abandon_plan__published_by_mistake._why: A plan nobody started has to be put down — published with the wrong goal, or left with no steps by a publish that failed half-way. Only a plan whose steps never left PENDING; the reason is required and lands in Deviations.
abandon_plan__published_by_mistake.reason: published with the wrong goal; replaced by deep-health-20260514154210

finish_plan._why: Rarely needed: the last regular step closes the plan. For back-filling a legacy plan, or force-finishing one with PENDING steps.

agent_review_close__fallback._why: Fallback only: normally you complete-step / fail-step the <plan>-REVIEW.1 child and the plan closes itself. Use this for a NEEDS_REVIEW plan that has no child step.
agent_review_close__fallback.summary: State graph re-indexed; no stale references to the renamed probe functions.

reason_fill__one_of_each_shape._why: One answer per slot from reason-slots; run_id comes from the slots. The shape decides the tier: span = stated, interpretation = asserted, unstated = unstated.
